'''Jualya Village''' was a [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] village located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]]. It was where the renowned [[light sculptor]] [[Ves Volette]] grew up.<ref name="sos" />
